quality.cohortBasis: Observed enrichment-completion day (ET). Later losses update that same cohort; numerator and denominator never mix completion days.

ageAtDecision.basis: Hours from the observed completion window to the first recorded post-completion Tim decision; displayed as bounds, not invented exact completion times.

coverage.note: Historical completion/decision timestamps are incomplete. Baseline stock without an observed completion is excluded; missing history is not zero loss. Failed checks mean unconfirmed freshness, not proven closure. Posting age or an overdue check alone is not failure.

verification.basis: Observed distinct job transitions; baseline stock and partial field updates excluded. Counts / selected elapsed calendar hours. Short history and collection gaps are explicitly marked; only observed completions count.

criteria: Main flow: discovery, intake, enrichment and user decisions. Posting freshness is background maintenance. Enrichment: measured fit, salary, posting-based degree evidence and Writer-calculated final score with model provenance; posting freshness is independent background maintenance. Review queue: open and undecided, not a recommendation to apply. Closed postings are separate exits from processing. No canonical bucket changes.

reconciliation.basis: User worksheet edit; original observation timestamps preserved

discovery.basis: Distinct captured candidate identities first observed within 36 elapsed hours; intake is not required. Repeat sources are deduplicated and proven canonical aliases are merged. Unproven cross-source duplicates remain candidates.

intake.basis: Distinct canonical master/archive jobs with an exact admission timestamp in 36 hours.
